fixes.explanation: False is right, friend. The Spirit rested on the seventy elders and they prophesied, but the text says they never did so again (Numbers 11:25). It happened that one time. Like a cookie box that gets one star and then the sky just keeps shining on its own, that day was a one-time moment and the text doesn't say more.

problems.problem: The recipe comparison suggests repeated attempts that no longer work. The text says the elders never prophesied again, not that they tried and could not. The joke does not match the action.
